input.prompt: Character model sheet for 3D reconstruction of the VYBS astronaut mascot shown in the reference images (Image 1 turnaround, Image 2 pose sheet, Image 3 jump pose). Exactly four equal square panels side by side in one row, the same character at the same scale in every panel, feet on the same baseline, the character centred in its panel with empty margin around it. Panel 1: FRONT view, looking straight at the camera. Panel 2: LEFT side view, the character turned so its left side faces the camera and it looks toward the left edge of the image. Panel 3: BACK view, showing the deep-indigo backpack. Panel 4: RIGHT side view, the character turned so its right side faces the camera and it looks toward the right edge of the image. Pose in every panel: neutral A-pose for rigging. Standing straight, arms held down and out away from the body at about 40 degrees so there is clear empty space between each arm and the torso, mitten hands relaxed, legs straight and slightly apart with a gap between them. Orthographic camera at chest height, no perspective, no tilt. Render style: a clean soft 3D toy figure, smooth matte vinyl, soft even studio light, gentle ambient occlusion, no outlines, no texture noise. Plain flat light-grey background (#E9ECEF) behind every panel. No text, no labels, no numbers, no grid lines, no panel borders, no floor, no cast shadows. The character: a small, chunky, chibi astronaut. An oversized round helmet in pale icy white-blue (#E6F9FE), roughly as tall as the body below it, a smooth plain dome whose left and right sides are completely flat and bare, the same icy white-blue all the way round. A large rounded-rectangle visor in deep indigo (#3A43C4) with a soft lavender rim (#A8B1E7) and one lighter-indigo (#686FD2) diagonal reflection band across its lower part. There is NO face inside the visor: the expression is made only of four-pointed sparkle stars — by default a large white sparkle on the left and a smaller warm-yellow (#FCD748) sparkle on the right. A pale grey-blue collar ring (#B0D5E5) joins the helmet to the body. A rounded, pale icy white-blue suit with stubby arms, mitten hands and short legs ending in pale grey-blue (#B0D5E5) boot soles, the same pale grey-blue as the collar ring. A rounded-square deep-indigo chest panel and one deep-indigo belt stripe around the waist. On its back, a deep-indigo backpack with a small lavender slot. MANDATORY identity marks, always visible whenever the front of the body shows: the rounded-square deep-indigo chest panel in the middle of the torso and the deep-indigo belt stripe around the waist. Same proportions, same colours and same shapes as the reference images. Never add: ear pods or side discs on the helmet, antennas, zippers, seams, pockets, patches, logos, lettering on the suit, or a visible face, eyes, nose or mouth.
